result: I would rewire the underlying incentive structure of how human systems operate. Almost every major system we've built—economies, politics, technology, media, education—rewards extraction, short-term domination, and zero-sum competition. Flip that so that genuine collaboration, long-term stewardship, and mutual resilience become the most reliable paths to prosperity, security, and social respect. When the rules of the game naturally align with flourishing rather than exploitation, the constant friction of trying to "fix" human coordination largely disappears. The systems themselves start doing the work.
